page.title: Cellular Settings
page.description: Network technologies, SIM slot and the APN of the data connection.

network_mode.title: Network Mode
network_mode.description: Technologies the modem may register on. Current: {{mode}}

nr5g_mode.title: 5G Mode
nr5g_mode.description: Whether 5G is used with an LTE anchor (NSA), standalone (SA), or either.

sim_slot.title: SIM Slot
sim_slot.description: SIM 2 is also the eSIM. Switching restarts the registration.

apn.title: APN
apn.description: Profile 1 carries the data connection. Saving removes the other profiles and restarts the radio.

confirm.apn_description: The radio restarts to attach with the new APN: the connection drops for a few seconds.
confirm.reset_description: Every APN profile is deleted and the modem reboots; the operator defaults apply afterwards.
confirm.sim_description: The modem registers again with the other SIM: the connection drops until it is done.
